articles.headline: Nvidia to buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
articles.summary: This deal would deepen Nvidia’s control over the AI stack by combining chips, developer distribution, and model hosting. For businesses, it could influence AI vendor strategy, pricing power, and the pace at which open-source AI gets packaged into enterprise tools.

articles.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra in phased rollout to select organizations
articles.summary: The rollout points to a new round of competition in business automation, with early access likely focused on enterprise use cases. Companies should watch for changes in productivity tooling, workflow automation, and model safety requirements before wider adoption.

articles.headline: Google Workspace adds new AI and automation updates across Meet, Docs, and Gemini Enterprise
articles.summary: Google’s updates expand automation and agent features for everyday work, including new workflow steps and broader enterprise search across connected data sources. That matters for businesses assessing whether to standardize on Google’s stack to cut admin time and reduce workflow friction.
